pick.name: Raycast
pick.what: Launcher with clipboard history, snippets, window management and thousands of extensions
pick.why: Best launcher on macOS, now also on Windows; free tier does not expire
pick.free_limits: Free: core features and extensions, no AI; Pro $10/mo ($96/yr) adds AI, cloud sync, dictation
pick.install: brew install --cask raycast | winget install raycast (or Microsoft Store)

alts.name: PowerToys
alts.what: Microsoft utilities: FancyZones, Run launcher, Workspaces

alts.name: GlazeWM
alts.what: i3-style tiling window manager for Windows

candidates.name: komorebi
candidates.verdict: Commercial use needs paid licence; avoid

candidates.name: Alfred / Rectangle / Ulauncher
candidates.verdict: Mac/Linux staples; not verified this pass

decision: Raycast is the best launcher on macOS and now Windows, and its free tier is generous. On Windows PowerToys is the free first-party route; on Linux use your desktop's launcher. Avoid komorebi for commercial work without its paid licence.

os_notes.macOS: Raycast; a snapping tool such as Rectangle (not verified).
os_notes.Linux: No Raycast; use a desktop launcher/tiling setup (not verified).

verify.note: Pricing verified: Free usable in organisations; Pro $10/mo or $96/yr.
